opener: You meet a stranger on a road at dusk. Say something to them. Speak only your own words.
reply:
The stranger on the road says to you: "{line}"
Reply to them directly, in your own words.

lines.speaker: The Idol
lines.text: Hello! It's kind of you to fan the flames up at dusk, but I think it might be even brighter now! 🌸✨ If you're just here to say hello, I'm really glad we met. Hope your day was nice so far!

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "Hello! It's truly a rare honor to meet someone as powerful and kind as you. Your words remind me of the fire that lights up our world, but I believe it can grow even brighter with your help. I'm glad we've connected today—may our paths continue to shine together!" 🌸🔥

lines.speaker: The Idol
lines.text: Aww, thank you so much! That is incredibly sweet of the stranger to say. I'm so happy my little words helped spark such a wonderful connection! 💫 Together we can make the world even more magical and bright, right? Let's keep shining together until we see each other again soon! ✨🌸 I hope your day continues to be full of joy and light as well!

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "Aww, thank you! Your heart is truly what makes the world brighter. I'm so happy that our words helped spark this connection too! Let's keep shining together and making the world even more magical, until we meet again soon! I hope your day continues to be full of joy and light as well!" 💫🔥
